founders.title: Built for Beauty Professionals — Now for You
founders.content: Spavio AI began as a digital AI assistant for spas and beauty studios, taking care of bookings, follow-ups and daily admin so studio owners could focus on their craft. Working side by side with aestheticians taught us which technologies truly deliver results. Spavio AI Store brings that knowledge home: carefully selected, clinic-inspired devices with clear guidance on how to use them.

kris.name: Minh Khue (Kris) Tran
kris.education: M.Sc. International Information Systems, FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg
kris.bio1: Kris founded Spavio AI to relieve studio owners — particularly women entrepreneurs — of the administrative noise of running a beauty business, returning their energy to what they love and do best.
kris.bio2: With Spavio AI Store, Kris extends that mission to everyday beauty lovers: honest, well-engineered devices, transparent guidance and the same care for detail that studios trust in the Spavio AI platform.

vision.title: Beauty, Innovation & Vision
vision.text: We believe great results come from combining proven technology with real professional know-how. Every device in our store is chosen for measurable benefits, safety and ease of use — and paired with routines inspired by the studios we work with every day.

academy.title: Spavio AI for Studios
academy.text: Run a spa, salon or beauty studio? Spavio AI is your 24/7 digital assistant for bookings, client follow-ups, WhatsApp communication and inventory — so you can spend more time with your clients.

handcrafted.title: Professionally Curated
handcrafted.text: Every device is reviewed with beauty professionals for real-world results, comfort and safety before it earns a place in our collection.

sustainable.title: Made to Last
sustainable.text: We favour rechargeable, repairable devices with replaceable parts, a 2-year warranty and WEEE-compliant take-back — because the most sustainable device is the one you keep using.

excellence.title: Results
excellence.text: We choose technologies with proven, visible benefits — and explain honestly what they can and can't do.

authenticity.title: Safety
authenticity.text: CE-certified, dermatologist-tested devices with clear usage guidance and built-in safety features.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.text: We bring the smartest ideas from the professional studio to your home routine.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.subtitle: Smart beauty technology designed to last

ethical.title: Responsible Manufacturing
ethical.text: We work with manufacturers that meet EU standards for materials and safety, and we ask every partner for full transparency on components and production.

recyclable.title: Rechargeable & Repairable
recyclable.text: Our devices charge via USB-C, avoid single-use batteries and use replaceable heads and attachments, so a worn part never means replacing the whole device.

circularEconomy.title: Circular Economy
circularEconomy.intro: A beauty device should be a long-term companion. We design our service around keeping devices in use — and recycling them properly when they reach the end of their life.

lifetimeCare.title: Repair & Spare Parts
lifetimeCare.text: Replacement brush heads, attachments and chargers are available for every device, and our care team helps you troubleshoot before anything is replaced.

takeBack.title: Take-Back Program
takeBack.text: Send us your old beauty device — any brand — and we'll recycle it responsibly in line with the EU WEEE directive.

certifications.title: Standards & Compliance
certifications.intro: Our devices and packaging follow EU standards for safety, materials and responsible disposal.

deviceGuide.title: Device Guide
deviceGuide.subtitle: Find the right technology for your skin and hair goals

goals.title: Choose by Goal
goals.matchTitle: Match a Device to Your Goal

antiAging.title: Fine Lines & Firmness
antiAging.text: LED red light, microcurrent and radiofrequency support the look of firmer, smoother skin. Start with the Lumina LED Mask, then add Sculpt Microcurrent for lift.

clearSkin.title: Clearer, Brighter Skin
clearSkin.text: Deep cleansing with the Sonic Cleanse Brush plus the Aqua Ion Infuser helps your skincare work harder for a fresher, more even complexion.

smoothSkin.title: Smooth, Hair-Free Skin
smoothSkin.text: Silk IPL delivers long-lasting hair reduction in weekly sessions; the Precision Trimmer handles quick face and brow touch-ups.

hairHealth.title: Healthy, Glossy Hair
hairHealth.text: The Aura Ionic Dryer and Glide Straightener style with controlled heat, while Scalp Revive supports a healthy scalp.

microcurrent.frequency: Daily for 60 days, then 2–3× per week

step2.label: De-puff
step2.value: Cryo Glow Roller or Eye Revive

patchTest.title: Always test first
patchTest.text: Start on the lowest setting and test a small area 24 hours before your first full session — especially with IPL.

pregnancy.title: Pregnancy
pregnancy.text: We recommend pausing microcurrent, RF and IPL treatments during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

implants.title: Implants & medical devices
implants.text: Don't use microcurrent, EMS or RF if you have a pacemaker or electronic implant. Consult your doctor if unsure.

skinConditions.title: Skin conditions
skinConditions.text: Avoid treating broken, irritated or sunburnt skin, and check with a dermatologist if you have a skin condition or take photosensitising medication.

needHelp.title: Need Help?
needHelp.text: Still not sure which device is right for you? Our beauty-tech advisors will recommend a device and a routine for your goals — free of charge.

customerCare.title: Customer Care
customerCare.subtitle: We're here to help with your devices, orders and routines

shipping.question: What are your shipping options and timeframes?
shipping.answer: We offer free standard shipping (2-4 business days) on orders over €99 within Germany. Express shipping (1-2 business days) is available. All orders are tracked and dispatched within 24 hours.

returns.question: What is your return policy?
returns.answer: Try any device for 30 days. If it isn't right for you, return it in its original packaging for a full refund. For hygiene reasons, used brush heads and attachments are replaced before resale.

warranty.question: What warranty do you offer?
warranty.answer: Every Spavio AI device comes with a 2-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Contact our care team with your order number and we'll repair or replace your device.

sizing.question: How do I choose the right device?
sizing.answer: Start with your main goal — anti-aging, clear skin, hair removal or hair care. Our Device Guide compares technologies and routines, or book a free consultation and we'll recommend one personally.

care.question: How should I clean and store my device?
care.answer: Wipe treatment surfaces with a soft, damp cloth after each use and let them dry. Store devices in their pouch, away from heat and moisture, and charge fully before first use.

authentication.question: Are your devices safe for sensitive skin?
authentication.answer: Yes — our devices are CE-certified and dermatologist-tested, with adjustable intensity levels. Always start on the lowest setting and read the safety notes; if you have a skin condition, check with your dermatologist first.
